## History

Harmon Andrews is a member of the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) community whose household family events unfold over time. His relative [Billy Andrews](../character/billy-andrews.md) eventually gets married, marking one of the shifts in local community life observed by neighbors. Through letters sent from [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), news of local occurrences and gossip surrounding the Andrews family continues to be shared with former residents living away from home.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P2](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P3](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. ## Quotes

> "Well, the over-particular girls generally get left, I notice. And what’s this I hear about Gilbert Blythe being engaged to a Miss Stuart? Charlie Sloane tells me she is perfectly beautiful. Is it true?"
>
> — Harmon Andrews — [v3 ch.Weddings P29](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0029)

> “I once thought you and Gilbert would have made a match of it,” said Mrs. Harmon. “If you don’t take care, Anne, all of your beaux will slip through your fingers.”
>
> — Harmon Andrews — [v3 ch.Weddings P31](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0031)

> “Do,” said Mrs. Harmon effusively. “Jane isn’t a bit proud. She just means to associate with her old friends the same as ever. She’ll be real glad to see you.”
>
> — Harmon Andrews — [v3 ch.Weddings P34](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0034)

## Relationships

### [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/harmon-andrews--jane-andrews.md)

Harmon Andrews is closely linked to [Jane](../character/jane.md), famously catching her by her sash to prevent her from falling overboard into the lake during a picnic. While their shared activities center around community events and local gatherings, their bond reflects typical village camaraderie. Later news of Jane's upcoming marriage to a wealthy man marks a shift as her social standing expands beyond their shared local circle.

- Saved — caught her by her sash as she nearly fell overboard into the lake  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P68](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0068)</sub>
